description: BeatBrowser — a local MCP toolkit for your signed-in Chrome. Use it across compatible agents.
author: BeatAPI

tool_signatures.name: act
tool_signatures.description: Your DEFAULT way to act — batch every step you can predict (on form wizards, nearly all). Each step is effect-checked, ONE snapshot returns at the end; every call you merge saves a full model turn. Stops early on no-effect / failure / submit-pay-delete controls.

tool_signatures.name: ask
tool_signatures.description: Hand control back to the user for one step, then continue. For captcha, QR login, SMS/OTP, or any confirmation that should be a human decision. Brings the tab forward, shows a panel, highlights your targets, sends a desktop notification, and blocks until the user acts. Use it instead of retrying a step that needs a human. A

tool_signatures.name: browser_task
tool_signatures.description: Execute browser_task

tool_signatures.name: click
tool_signatures.description: Click ONE element by ref. Know your next step already? Use

tool_signatures.name: download
tool_signatures.description: Download a URL using Chrome as a fallback when fetch with binary:true and savePath cannot handle it. Try via:

tool_signatures.name: eval
tool_signatures.description: Run a JS expression in the page. NOTE: fails on any site with a strict CSP (no unsafe-eval) — most large sites. Prefer

tool_signatures.name: fetch
tool_signatures.description: Call a URL from inside the page, carrying the user\

tool_signatures.name: fill
tool_signatures.description: Fill a whole form in ONE call, all refs from the same snapshot. Field: {ref, text} for inputs, {ref, value} for <select>, {ref, check} for checkbox/radio. submit:true submits after (skipped if any field failed).

tool_signatures.name: key
tool_signatures.description: Press a key: Escape, Enter, Tab, arrows (custom dropdowns), Backspace/Delete, or a combo. Without ref it goes to whatever is focused. For entering text use type.

tool_signatures.name: learnings
tool_signatures.description: Site notes: APIs, walls, pitfalls from past sessions. Call {domain} before first acting on a site (no args = list sites). Notes may embed runnable

tool_signatures.name: navigate
tool_signatures.description: Go to a URL, or go back/forward/reload. Returns the new page snapshot. Runs in the user\

tool_signatures.name: network
tool_signatures.description: START HERE when you need DATA rather than an action. Lists the XHR/fetch calls the page made, then returns one response body via

tool_signatures.name: query
tool_signatures.description: Extract structured data by CSS selector (lists, tables), or FIND BY TEXT with

tool_signatures.name: read_text
tool_signatures.description: Extract the main readable content of the page as markdown, with boilerplate stripped. Use for reading articles/docs; use snapshot when you need to interact.

tool_signatures.name: reload
tool_signatures.description: Reload the beat-browser extension (chrome.runtime.reload()) so an updated build takes effect — no manual chrome://extensions visit needed. ~2s; bridge auto-reconnects, tabs keep state. DISRUPTIVE: the extension is shared by every tab and every other agent session on this machine — anything mid-flight elsewhere gets cut. Only call right after installing/updating, or when \

tool_signatures.name: screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Screenshot the controlled tab, background tabs included. Prefer snapshot / read_text — they cost far less. Returned at 60% scale as JPEG by default; full:true for 1:1 PNG (e.g. to read small text or measure pixels).

tool_signatures.name: scroll
tool_signatures.description: Scroll to load more of a lazy list. Auto-detects inner scroll containers, stops early once height stops growing. Prefer network/fetch for bulk data. Background tabs render no frames, so an IntersectionObserver-driven list may refuse to grow — the tool says so when it happens.

tool_signatures.name: select
tool_signatures.description: Choose an option in a <select> by ref.

tool_signatures.name: snapshot
tool_signatures.description: Capture the current page as a compact list of interactive elements with refs and state (value/checked/selected/expanded/disabled), plus dialogs, alerts and a text excerpt. Call this before any click/type. Cheap — prefer it over screenshots or eval. Refs ending in @fN live in an iframe: pass them through unchanged, they route themselves.

tool_signatures.name: spaces
tool_signatures.description: BeatBrowser-owned background task window. Open creates a minimized Chrome window using existing logins; pass its tabId on all browser calls. No Ego app is required. User focus pauses control. Handoff alone brings the window forward; resume requires explicit user instruction. Finish releases control and keeps evidence tabs. After reconnect, list spaces to restore routing. Recovered tasks remain paused; claim with userConfirmed:true can connect a new agent session after explicit user instruction, then inspect before resuming.

tool_signatures.name: status
tool_signatures.description: One short sentence telling the user what you are about to do, shown on an on-page panel. Call before a multi-step task and whenever the plan changes. Instant, never blocks. Use the user\

tool_signatures.name: tabs
tool_signatures.description: List / open / switch / close tabs. New tabs open in the BACKGROUND and become the controlled tab — the user keeps looking at whatever they were on. Everything except screenshot works fine on a background tab. Each agent session has its OWN controlled tab; omitting tabId uses this session\

tool_signatures.name: type
tool_signatures.description: Type text into ONE input/textarea/contenteditable by ref. Set submit:true to press Enter after. More fields coming? Use

tool_signatures.name: upload
tool_signatures.description: Attach a local file to the page (no extension can touch the OS file picker). Open the upload UI first. Auto-picks a matching file input; for editors that only accept drag-and-drop (X Article, Notion) pass dropSelector instead. Any size via a file input (browser reads the path); drag-drop caps at 48MB.

tool_signatures.name: wait
tool_signatures.description: Wait until a selector appears, text shows up, or the network goes idle. Use after actions that load content.
